name: keltner_channel_trend_v1
mechanism: On NIFTY, when the index sustains above its 5-minute Keltner Channel upper band (EMA(60) + 2×ATR(60)) for 3 consecutive 5-second bars, it signals institutional directional flow has overwhelmed the volatility-adjusted supply ceiling — the band is harder to breach than Bollinger Bands because ATR widens in choppy conditions, so a sustained breach specifically means price velocity exceeds current micro-volatility regime, not just a single-bar noise spike. TWAP/VWAP algorithms filling large directional orders continue pushing for 30-90 seconds as only 40-60% of institutional orders are typically filled at the breakout bar. The ADX(36) filter confirms that +DI and -DI have diverged meaningfully over the past 3 minutes, validating that the breakout is driven by directional flow rather than a two-sided auction spike.
core_signal_oneliner: Sustained 15-second breach of 5-minute Keltner band above VWAP with ADX trend strength confirmation
